sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that although the allegations pertain to defrauding the complainant of an amount of Rs.10 lakhs, but the present case is a case where the petitioner has been roped in simply on account of the fact that she happens to be the wife of CRM-M-17773 17773-2024 (O&M) Parveen Kumar, who according to the complainant is the main accused.

It has been submitted that since an amount of Rs.3 lakhs is alleged to have been transferred by co-accused co accused Parveen Kumar into the account of the present present petitioner, the petitioner in order to prove her bonafides is ready and willing to deposit the said amount before the trial Court.
Notice of motion for 13.08.2024.
At this stage, Mr. Jitender K. Sehrawat, Advocate, has put in appearance on behalf of the complainant and has filed MoA, which is taken on record.
He prays for and is granted time to file Power of Attorney.

The petitioner, as per her offer, may deposit the aforesaid amount before the trial Court/Illaqa Court Illaqa Magistrate within 10 days from today, which shall be got invested in FDR in some Nationalized Bank.

The trial Court/Illaqa Magistrate shall,
however, issue specific directions to the Bank concerned not to entertain any request for encashment of the same except under orders of the Court.

Subjectt to depositing the aforesaid amount before the trial Court within a period of 10 days, the petitioner, in the event of arrest, is ordered to be released on interim bail subject to her furnishing personal bonds and surety bonds to the satisfaction of Arres Arresting/Investigating ting/Investigating Officer.

However, the petitioner shall join the investigation as and when called upon to do so and cooperate with the Investigating Officer and shall also abide by the conditions as provided under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
Cr.P.C."
3.
Today, learned earned counsel for the petitioner submits that pursuant to the aforesaid directions, the petitioner has joined investigation and had also deposited an amount of Rs.3 lakhs.
A photocopy of the Confirmation of Deposit in FD-Sugam FD Deposit has been furnished, which is taken on record.
4. A perusal of the aforesaid Fixed Deposit would show that the aforesaid deposit has been made in the name of the petitioner herself.

The concerned Bank Manager is directed to ensure that the aforesaid FD is CRM-M-17773 17773-2024 (O&M) not got encahsed encahsed unless there are specific directions either by this Court or by the trial Court/Illaqa Magistrate.

sentences.text: 5. Learned State counsel upon instructions has informed that pursuant to interim directions issued by this Court, the petitioner has since joined investigation and is not required for any custodial interrogation.

6. Having regard to the aforestated position, wherein the petitioner is stated to have joined joined investigation and is not required for any custodial interrogation, the petition is accepted and the interim directions issued by this Court vide order dated 10.04.2024 are hereby made absolute subject to the condition that the petitioner shall join in investigation vestigation as and when called upon to do so and cooperate with the Investigating Officer and shall also abide by the conditions as provided under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
7.

Upon the petitioner being declared innocent or being acquitted and such acquittal attains finality,
the petitioner shall be entitled to proceeds of the aforesaid said FDR.
However, in case the petitioner is found guilty and is convicted and such conviction attains finality, the complainant shall be entitled to proceeds of the FDR in question question.
